National Museum, New Delhi (Janpath) is closed today, Mon 26 Oct, 6:10 AM. It opens next on Tue 27 Oct, 10:00 AM.

Hours (official site)

Tue to Fri: 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM
Sat and Sun: 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM
Closed on Mondays and national holidays

Entry fee

Adults: ₹20
Foreign nationals: ₹500
Students up to class 12: free, with ID card

The site lists online tickets at zoonga.com/national-museum. The page shows no update date, so check the fee before you go.
